  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items meets an immediate need for me. Nuts and a bolt thread checker look related to fastening, but my recent needs involved framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors, which do different jobs.",
    "Cutting wheels and milling cutters assume metalworking needs that my recent purchases do not establish; buying construction fasteners does not mean I need machining supplies.",
    "The glass beakers do not replace the small disposable cups I chose for measuring and dispensing small amounts of liquid.",
    "The caliper has a plausible connection to hardware, but I have no current precision-measuring task. The fuel cans and infrared thermometer likewise serve needs I have not shown.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape would require a specific use and quantity need that I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My nail and screw purchases seem to have been treated as interest in workshop supplies generally, although I choose supplies for particular jobs.",
    "My purchase of measuring cups seems to have been interpreted as broader interest in measuring equipment, even though capacity, material, and intended use matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The dimensions, fastening method, and intended material in my recent nail and screw purchases matter more than a general connection to hardware.",
    "My recent purchases include specific household replacements, such as vacuum bags that fit particular Panasonic types; compatibility is a stronger reason to choose something than a loose connection to maintenance.",
    "I need an immediate practical use before choosing an item. A potentially useful tool or a large supply pack is not enough on its own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations picked up on my practical supply purchases but stretched them into broad workshop interests without matching the specific jobs, compatibility, or quantities I need."
}
